subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Divers found an old shipwreck carrying jars, tools, and pieces of wood.”?
options: Students could study without smoky fuel lamps.
Anyone could use the information to build apps or study problems.
Being able to study something does not automatically mean doing so without permission.
Removing objects without study destroys information.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Students could study without smoky fuel lamps.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Anyone could use the information to build apps or study problems.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Being able to study something does not automatically mean doing so without permission.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Removing objects without study destroys information.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Removing objects without study destroys information.」，答案為「Removing objects without study destroys information.」。
